build_get_tracing_config: build a call to get_tracing_config() that returns the full TracingConfig from environment variables
create_get_enabled_providers: create a call to get_enabled_tracing_providers() that returns a list of configured and enabled tracing providers
test_is_tracing_enabled: test is_tracing_enabled() to check if any tracing provider is enabled and fully configured
validate_validate_enabled_providers: validate validate_enabled_tracing_providers() to ensure all enabled providers have required keys set
review_get_explicitly_enabled: review get_explicitly_enabled_tracing_providers() to return providers explicitly enabled regardless of config completeness
